req.title: Delete cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall expire cookies named in the query string of GET /cookies/delete and redirect to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The delete_cookies handler at GET /cookies/delete reads cookie names from the query string, calls r.delete_cookie(key=key) for each, and returns a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path — named cookie is expired via Set-Cookie with past expiration and a 302 redirect to /cookies is issued; (2) negative path — no query params yields a 302 with no Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary — deleting multiple cookies simultaneously; (4) state transition — cookie present before delete is absent after following redirect; (5) decision table — only the named cookie is deleted, not others. Mutation resilience requires exact status code (302 not 200/301/303), exact Location header value (/cookies), exact Set-Cookie expiry semantics (expires in the past), and exact cookie name matching.

tests.name: test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie
preconditions: A cookie named 'session' exists in the request
actions: Send GET /cookies/delete?session= with Cookie: session=abc header
expected: Set-Cookie header for 'session' has an expiry date in the past (expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: system shall expire cookies named in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie():
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?session=', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == 'http://localhost/cookies' or location == '/cookies'
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    session_cookies = [h for h in set_cookie_headers if h.startswith('session=')]
    assert len(session_cookies) == 1
    sc = session_cookies[0].lower()
    assert 'expires=' in sc
    assert '1970' in sc or 'thu, 01 jan 1970' in sc

test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie()

tests.name: test_delete_multiple_cookies_simultaneously
actions: Send GET /cookies/delete?a=&b=&c= with Cookie: a=1; b=2; c=3
expected: Each of 'a', 'b', 'c' appears in Set-Cookie with past expiry
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: all cookies named in query string must be expired
BVA: boundary of multiple simultaneous deletions
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_multiple_cookies_simultaneously():
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?a=&b=&c=',
                   headers={'Cookie': 'a=1; b=2; c=3'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/cookies' in location
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 3
    names_expired = [h.split('=')[0] for h in set_cookie_headers]
    assert 'a' in names_expired
    assert 'b' in names_expired
    assert 'c' in names_expired
    for h in set_cookie_headers:
        assert '1970' in h.lower() or 'expires=' in h.lower()

test_delete_multiple_cookies_simultaneously()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_only_named_cookie_is_expired():
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?target=',
                   headers={'Cookie': 'target=x; keep=y'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    target_cookies = [h for h in set_cookie_headers if h.startswith('target=')]
    keep_cookies = [h for h in set_cookie_headers if h.startswith('keep=')]
    assert len(target_cookies) == 1
    assert len(keep_cookies) == 0
    assert '1970' in target_cookies[0].lower() or 'expires=' in target_cookies[0].lower()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect
actions: Verify cookie is absent via GET /cookies
expected: After set: cookies JSON contains mysession=hello
After delete: cookies JSON does not contain mysession key
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: state transition from cookie-present to cookie-absent
STC: set -> verify present -> delete -> verify absent
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect():
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        pass
    r_set = client.get('/cookies/set/mysession/hello')
    assert r_set.status_code == 302
    r_check = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r_check.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r_check.data)
    assert data['cookies'].get('mysession') == 'hello'
    r_del = client.get('/cookies/delete?mysession=')
    assert r_del.status_code == 302
    location = r_del.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/cookies' in location
    r_after = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    data_after = json.loads(r_after.data)
    assert 'mysession' not in data_after['cookies']

test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_exact_value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: redirect target must be /cookies exactly
BVA: exact redirect code 302 vs adjacent codes 301/303
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_exact_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 307
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/cookies')
    assert not location.endswith('/cookies/delete')
    assert not location.endswith('/cookies/set')

test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_exact_value()
